cues.en: Hi, and welcome to another video in AI in C#, where we look into the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看另一段 C# AI 影片，繼續介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework。

cues.en: In this video, we're going to look at how we can work with input data other than text.
cues.zh: 這段要看看，如何處理文字以外的輸入資料。

cues.en: So here we are in Visual Studio, and we have seen a lot of examples so far where we have just given some chat
cues.zh: 在 Visual Studio 裡，目前已經看過很多例子，都是傳入帶文字的 Chat

cues.en: message with some text, or just given the text directly here, same output.
cues.zh: Message，或直接在這裡傳入文字，結果相同。

cues.en: But what if we want to use other things?
cues.zh: 但如果要提供其他資料呢？

cues.en: These LLMs, or most of them, are multimodal, where they talk about they are able to work with images and PDFs and stuff.
cues.zh: 這些 LLM，大部分都是多模態模型，能處理影像、PDF 等內容。

cues.en: In the example, I have put in some scenarios for text, image, and PDF, because that is more or less what they can work
cues.zh: 範例裡準備了文字、影像和 PDF 情境，因為大致上就是這些支援的

cues.en: with.
cues.zh: 資料類型。

cues.en: Because if you try to upload a .txt file or some kind of file that you have, they just come back and say they
cues.zh: 如果試著直接上傳 .txt 或其他類型檔案，可能只會得到回應說，

cues.en: are not able to work with them, they are not able to process them.
cues.zh: 它無法處理這類檔案。

cues.en: And of course, if it's a file or some kind of content that it doesn't understand, you can, of course, use normal RAG or
cues.zh: 當然，如果資料格式不被理解，還是可以用一般的 RAG，也就是

cues.en: Retrival Augmented Generation, and put it, extract data out of a file, let's say you had some kind of technical specification in a format
cues.zh: 檢索增強生成，先從檔案取出資料。例如有一份技術規格，使用比較少見的

cues.en: that is not common.
cues.zh: 格式，

cues.en: You could, of course, take that data out and then just give it to the LLM as text.
cues.zh: 就可以先擷取內容，再以文字交給 LLM。

cues.en: But there's this few scenarios, images and PDFs, that are supported.
cues.zh: 但影像和 PDF 這幾種情境，本身是有支援的。

cues.en: In one of the cases, PDF is only partly supported, but let's see how that works.
cues.zh: 其中一種情況，PDF 只有部分支援，接著來看。

cues.en: And in order to run this sample, you need both Azure AI and OpenAI, because OpenAI
cues.zh: 要執行這個範例，需要 Azure OpenAI 和 OpenAI 兩邊都能使用，因為 OpenAI，

cues.en: actually have some features that they support that Azure OpenAI, for some reason, don't support.
cues.zh: 支援一些 Azure OpenAI 不知為何還不支援的功能。

cues.en: But let's have some breakpoints and let's start with the normal text, which is nothing special in the scenario.
cues.zh: 先設中斷點，從一般文字開始，這部分沒有特別之處。

cues.en: And we just used Azure OpenAI here, but both Azure and OpenAI, of course, can understand text.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 Azure OpenAI，但 Azure 和 OpenAI 當然都能理解文字。

cues.en: So what is the capital of France and a response back, that just says the capital of France is Paris.
cues.zh: 問「法國首都是哪裡？」，回應就是法國首都是巴黎。

cues.en: So nothing special there.
cues.zh: 沒有什麼特別的。

cues.en: Images are also supported.
cues.zh: 影像也受到支援。

cues.en: So let's run and see that whenever we use an image, we can either use an
cues.zh: 執行看看，提供影像時，可以使用一張

cues.en: image that are online, meaning a URL to an image.
cues.zh: 線上圖片，也就是圖片網址。

cues.en: So you can simply go in and say the chat message, instead of just writing the text, you can make a list of different things you want to send in.
cues.zh: 建立 ChatMessage 時，不只寫文字，也能放入一個內容清單，列出要送出的各種資料。

cues.en: In our case here, we want to send in a text content and a URI content, because if we just send the image, it
cues.zh: 這裡送入 TextContent 與 UriContent，因為如果只提供圖片，

cues.en: might not know what to do about it.
cues.zh: 模型不一定知道要做什麼。

cues.en: But in this case, we want to ask what is in the image and the image is a picture of the settlers of Catan.
cues.zh: 這裡問「圖片裡有什麼？」，圖片則是《卡坦島》。

cues.en: I can show it here, so we know what's going on.
cues.zh: 先展示一下圖片，讓你知道內容，

cues.en: Just bring it up on another screen and show that it's this image.
cues.zh: 從另一個螢幕拿過來，就是這張圖片。

cues.en: So we're asking, what is in this image?
cues.zh: 所以問題是「這張圖片裡有什麼？」。

cues.en: And if we do that, take a little longer, of course, and let me jump over
cues.zh: 執行後，當然會花比較久；我先切到

cues.en: here.
cues.zh: 這邊。

cues.en: So it can look at the image and tell what's in it.
cues.zh: 它能查看圖片，描述裡面有什麼。

cues.en: And we could have asked what colours are used in the image, what numbers are used, and so on.
cues.zh: 也可以問圖片用了哪些顏色、有哪些數字等等。

cues.en: So that's just image recognition and working with them.
cues.zh: 這就是影像辨識與相關處理，

cues.en: And it doesn't require any special model other than a multi-model.
cues.zh: 不需要其他特殊模型，只要支援多模態即可。

cues.en: And we can begin to see our input tokens are becoming bigger, because it needs to get the entire image and stuff.
cues.zh: 可以看到輸入 Token 開始變多，因為還要處理整張圖片等內容。

cues.en: If we have local files, I have the same image, just as an image.jpg. And I put in that it's only called image .jpg. So it's not like it's looking at
cues.zh: 如果是本機檔案，這裡同一張圖片只命名為 image.jpg。刻意用這個名稱，避免它是從

cues.en: the URL and figuring out it's settlers of Catan.
cues.zh: 網址猜出圖片是卡坦島。

cues.en: It's actually looking at the image.
cues.zh: 它是真的在看圖片。

cues.en: And images can be processed in two ways, either as Base64 with a data UI.
cues.zh: 本機影像可以透過兩種方式處理，一種是 Base64 的 Data URI，

cues.en: And then we will just ask what is the content of the image.
cues.zh: 然後一樣問圖片裡的內容。

cues.en: So we will see exactly the same response back, more or less, and taking the same amount of input tokens.
cues.zh: 回應大致相同，使用的輸入 Token 也差不多。

cues.en: And in the same manner, we can use the read-only memory, which is the three options we can send data to a system.
cues.zh: 同樣也能使用 ReadOnlyMemory。加上網址，總共有三種提供資料的方式。

cues.en: So in these cases, it's data content instead of UI content.
cues.zh: 這些情況使用 DataContent，而不是 UriContent，

cues.en: And we can see we get exactly the same message back.
cues.zh: 得到的訊息也完全相同。

cues.en: So nothing special there.
cues.zh: 因此沒有其他特別差異，

cues.en: And these work both for Azure AI and Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 影像處理在 Azure OpenAI 和 OpenAI 都可以使用。

cues.en: But then we come to PDFs.
cues.zh: 接著是 PDF。

cues.en: And let's run again.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，

cues.en: And in this case, I have taken a PDF that is the rules of settlers of
cues.zh: 這次使用的 PDF，是《卡坦島》的

cues.en: Catan, just to keep the same theme here.
cues.zh: 遊戲規則，延續同一個主題。

cues.en: And what we will see is that this is using the OpenAI agent, because if I had used the Azure OpenAI agent, it would have come back and said, hey, I don't
cues.zh: 可以看到，這裡改用 OpenAI 代理程式。如果用 Azure OpenAI，就會回覆，

cues.en: support files.
cues.zh: 它不支援檔案。

cues.en: So Azure OpenAI, for some reason, can only do this with images and not PDFs.
cues.zh: 所以不知為何，Azure OpenAI 目前只能這樣處理影像，不能處理 PDF。

cues.en: And it's not something that is anything about the agent framework.
cues.zh: 這不是 Agent Framework 的限制，

cues.en: It is the pure LLM behind the scenes that are the problem here, not the framework, because that doesn't care.
cues.zh: 問題來自底層服務或模型，而不是框架，框架本身不在乎這個差異。

cues.en: But if we have the rules here, because we can only work with local data and local inquisition, because if you have some UI,
cues.zh: 如果有規則檔案，這裡必須提供實際的本機資料；若原本是某個網址，

cues.en: you, of course, can download it, have it in memory and give it to the system.
cues.zh: 當然可以先下載，讀進記憶體，再交給系統。

cues.en: But we can't just point to a PDF out there in the world and say, what is in this PDF?
cues.zh: 但不能只指向網路上的 PDF，就直接問裡面有什麼。

cues.en: But if we get it as a base 64, just like before, we can ask, what is the winning conditions in Attach PDF?
cues.zh: 像前面一樣轉成 Base64 後，就能問：「附件 PDF 的獲勝條件是什麼？」。

cues.en: And this takes quite a while and takes like 15,000 tokens, because it's a long rule book with images and stuff.
cues.zh: 這會花不少時間，大約需要 15,000 個 Token，因為這份規則書很長，還有圖片。

cues.en: But had it been a simpler PDF with just text, it would probably go faster.
cues.zh: 如果是只有文字的簡單 PDF，應該會更快。

cues.en: So I get a response back, and it will tell that we need to reach 10 victory points, and it will even point out
cues.zh: 回應會告訴我們，需要取得十分勝利點數，還會指出，

cues.en: that is specified on page 5 and page 14 and tell a little about the rules.
cues.zh: 這項規則在第 5 頁和第 14 頁，並解釋相關規則。

cues.en: So that is fairly cool, but we can see other token costs, of course.
cues.zh: 很不錯，但當然也能看到增加的 Token 成本。

cues.en: And data in memory works exactly the same way.
cues.zh: 直接提供記憶體中的資料，運作方式也相同，

cues.en: And again, it's only possible using OpenAI agent.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，目前這個範例只有 OpenAI 可以做到。

cues.en: So it is thinking for the next one, and then we are done.
cues.zh: 它正在思考下一個回應，完成後這個部分就結束。

cues.en: But we'll get the same answer back, of course.
cues.zh: 理論上會得到相同答案，

cues.en: But actually making a small failure here that says it's on page 7, it's about it and not page 14.
cues.zh: 但這次出現一個小錯誤，說內容在第 7 頁，而不是第 14 頁。

cues.en: So that's AI for you.
cues.zh: 這就是 AI 的特性。

cues.en: So again, other files, I have tried to put in .txt and so on, and it
cues.zh: 至於其他檔案，我也試過直接提供 .txt 等類型，

cues.en: doesn't seem to really be able to understand that.
cues.zh: 看起來仍無法理解，

cues.en: It just says, I can't process external files like that.
cues.zh: 只會說，不能以這種方式處理外部檔案。

cues.en: And that is the case where you need to use your C-sharp skills to extract data from the various files and give it
cues.zh: 這時就需要發揮 C# 能力，從各種檔案擷取資料，再以

cues.en: as text for the system or convert something to PDFs and give it that way.
cues.zh: 文字提供給系統，或先轉成 PDF 再提供。

cues.en: So if we look at this, you can see we can give this list of contents.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，我們能傳入這樣的內容清單。

cues.en: And you can see there's a bunch of other contents here, but these are both input and output content.
cues.zh: 其實還有很多其他 Content 型別，但其中同時包含輸入和輸出內容。

cues.en: And we are not really going to send at any point an error content.
cues.zh: 我們通常不會主動傳入 ErrorContent，

cues.en: That is for the LLM to send back the MCP tool call results and things like that.
cues.zh: 那是 LLM 或工具呼叫結果等回傳的內容。

cues.en: Hosted files, if it's up in Azure AI Foundry, it will give it back as a hosted file.
cues.zh: 如果檔案託管在 Azure AI Foundry，則可能回傳 HostedFileContent，

cues.en: So don't give the file back, but it gives a reference to the file that you can then download by yourself to save tokens.
cues.zh: 不是直接回傳整個檔案，而是提供檔案參照，讓你自行下載，節省 Token。

cues.en: So that is actually everything there is to this.
cues.zh: 這就是這個主題的主要內容。

cues.en: Of course, if you work with images and PDFs, it's very simple, but the rest is extraction and giving as text instead.
cues.zh: 影像和 PDF 的處理很簡單，其他格式則先擷取成文字，再提供給模型。

cues.en: So see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下段影片見。
